name: SeaTable
category_description: App node - connects to an external service API
description: Use the SeaTable node to automate work in SeaTable, and integrate SeaTable with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of SeaTable features, including creating, updating, deleting, updating, and getting rows
subtitle: ={{$parameter["resource"] + ": " + $parameter["operation"]}}

options.name: Create
options.description: Create a new row

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete a row

options.name: Get
options.description: Get the content of a row

options.name: Get Many
options.description: Get many rows from a table or a table view

options.name: Lock
options.description: Lock a row to prevent further changes

options.name: Search
options.description: Search one or multiple rows

options.name: Unlock
options.description: Remove the lock from a row

options.name: Update
options.description: Update the content of a row

parameters.description: Whether to use the column default values to populate new rows during creation (only available for normal backend)

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: In this mode, make sure the incoming data fields are named the same as the columns in SeaTable. (Use an "Edit Fields" node before this node to change them if required.)

parameters.name: inputsToIgnore
parameters.description: List of input properties to avoid sending, separated by commas. Leave empty to send all properties.

parameters.name: columnsUi
parameters.description: Add destination column with its value. Provide the value in this way. Date: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm. Duration: time in seconds. Checkbox: true, on or 1. Multi-Select: comma-separated list.

parameters.name: bigdata
parameters.description: Whether write to Big Data backend (true) or not (false). True requires the activation of the Big Data backend in the base.

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: Hint: Link, files, images or digital signatures have to be added separately. These column types cannot be set with this node.

options.name: simple

options.name: convert
options.description: Whether to return the column keys (false) or the column names (true)

options.description: Whether the search ignores case sensitivity (true). Otherwise, it distinguishes between uppercase and lowercase characters.

options.name: wildcard
options.description: Whether the search only results perfect matches (true). Otherwise, it finds a row even if the search value is part of a string (false).
